strongest_partial_result: Existing Matsuda-Oguni embeddings plus the proved connected-tail lemma give proper actions of closed surface groups on locally finite hyperbolic graphs with connected limit set and no equivariant Cannon-Thurston map; the boundary action is not geometrically finite.
